WhyHanin.title: Working at HANIN
WhyHanin.description: A production environment with clear technical procedures and occupational safety rules. Each position has specific job requirements and a mentor.

pillar1.title: A Safe Work Environment
pillar1.desc: The workshop has an automatic plating line, full protective equipment and a separate testing area.

pillar2.title: Career Development
pillar2.desc: Develop along a specialist or management track; work results are assessed periodically.

pillar3.title: Technical Training
pillar3.desc: New staff receive internal guidance on the plating process, plating thickness measurement and line operation.

pillar4.title: Compensation and Benefits
pillar4.desc: Pay based on ability; insurance and allowances per regulations and company policy.
